verdict.justification: The project aims to develop a web-based evaluation tool for first-year Systems Engineering students at Universidad del Valle Sede Tuluá. The tool is based on fuzzy logic and uses Likert scales to evaluate variables such as Motivation and Communication Interpersonal, as well as Mathematical Logic. The results are presented in a general and individual manner, enriching the way students' academic levels are evaluated. Although the project does not have a dedicated game loop, it is an educational artifact designed for learning purposes.
